rendering_pipeline.render_path: offline cinematic path-traced 3D render, stylized surreal dreamscape

key_light.type: cool celestial dome + small moon key

light_shadow.ambient_type: hemispheric sky ambient, magenta horizon bounce

shadows.type: soft contact shadow, very low contrast

fog.type: thin low-lying water mist, aerial perspective

material.name: xuanwu turtle shell with gold seams
material.brdf: smooth lacquered shell + metallic gold inlay

water.wave_technique: near-still normal perturbation, concentric ripple rings only

composition.type: symmetrically framed dreamscape, rule of thirds with low horizon
composition.symmetry_axis: bilateral vertical axis on turtle shots (frame_03-05); off-center rule of thirds on horse/fox shots

qiyun_shengdong.evidence: frame_01/02 flowing lavender silk robe trails on the white horse; frame_03-05 turtle gliding weightlessly on mirror water; frame_06 woman's hand gently meeting fox's nose — pervasive ethereal breath-like qi across all six frames.

gufa_yongbi.evidence: frame_01 clean silhouette of horse and woman against indigo sky; frame_06 crisp contour of fox and lotus rocks; though 3D-rendered, edge language is smooth and calligraphic rather than painterly.

yingwu_xiangxing.evidence: frame_03-05 anatomically coherent giant xuanwu tortoise with plated shell and steady limb; frame_06 white fox spirit with natural seated posture; frame_01 celestial horse proportions elegant but stylized.

suilei_fucai.evidence: frame_01/06 tree canopies rendered as self-luminous pink-orange cumulus (#f9a8d4 to #fb923c) rather than green leaves; frame_03-05 sky graded to magenta (#c026d3) horizon — non-naturalistic symbolic coloring characteristic of 随类赋彩.

jingying_weizhi.evidence: frame_03-05 strict bilateral symmetry: two cloud trees flanking, turtle centered on mirror water; frame_01 two cloud trees framing horse and woman; frame_06 large cloud tree left, lotus rocks right balancing empty blue space.

chuanyi_moxie.evidence: frame_03-05 evokes xuanwu (turtle) from 四象 mythology; frame_01 celestial white horse 天马; frame_06 white fox spirit 青丘; references 国风古韵 / 山海经 iconography recomposed into a modern dreamscape.

effect_to_library_mapping.library: procedural volumetric SSS cloud + emissive shader

motion.camera_motion_type: slow lateral dolly + gentle push-in, near-static contemplative framing
motion.transition_type: hard cut between creature vignettes (horse → turtle → fox)
